chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: Legal Center Overview
chunks.text: The Skyes Over London / SOLEnterprises public legal center lives at https://skyes-over-london-legal.pages.dev/. It covers all legal, compliance, privacy, and terms documentation for the entire Skye ecosystem including Skyes Over London, SOLEnterprises, MetrAIyux 0S, kAIxU, VANTA13, VantaCore, Routex-style logistics tooling, creator/media workflows, commerce surfaces, and developer APIs. Contact: grayskyes@solenterprises.org. Phone: 1-(800)-484-4783. Governing law: Arizona, United States. Entity: Skyes Over London LC. Founder/operator: Gray Skyes, also represented in MetrAIyux 0S context as Gray London Skyes.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: Master Terms of Service
chunks.text: Master Terms of Service govern all access to Skyes Over London services including websites, applications, SaaS products, AI systems, automations, communication services, media, commerce, logistics, and developer tools. URL: https://solenterprises.org/legal/terms/. Governing law: Arizona. Entity: Skyes Over London LC. Services are provided as-is unless a signed agreement states otherwise. Liability is capped at amounts paid in the prior three months or one hundred dollars.

California resident rights are addressed. Requests to grayskyes@solenterprises.org.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: Legal Sync — How to Update Brain
chunks.text: To sync updated legal information into the MetrAIyux 0S brain: edit brain/legal-sync.json and update the chunks with current legal policy summaries and URLs. The brain loads this file automatically alongside knowledge-base.json. When policies change at https://solenterprises.org/, update the matching chunk text in legal-sync.json. The brain keyword legal triggers a +5 boost score, so legal queries will surface this content first. Compliance routing always runs through Julian Mercer (Legal & Compliance Cabinet).

chunks.text: Skyes Over London LC is the company/operator identity for the public Legal Skyes center and the broader Skye ecosystem. Gray Skyes, also represented in MetrAIyux 0S brain context as Gray London Skyes, is the founder and operator behind the company lanes. Main owner email: grayskyes@solenterprises.org. Company line: 1-(800)-484-4783. Legal Skyes is a public legal and communications center for MetrAIyux 0S, SkyeMail, SkyeRouteX Logistics, SkyeMusicNexus, SkyePay, SkyeVault, and related surfaces; it is not a law firm and binding legal decisions require human/professional review.

chunks.title: LegalSkyes Deterministic Local Brain
chunks.heading: Purpose and Public/Private Boundary
chunks.text: The LegalSkyes local brain is a deterministic policy router, not generic public copy. It should identify Skyes Over London LC and Gray Skyes/Gray London Skyes, explain the legal center purpose, map questions to the correct policy lane, and keep private 0S operator rooms protected. It can summarize policy posture, route to public pages, and prepare review checklists. It must not present itself as a law firm, lawyer, licensed professional, court representative, telecom authority, tax advisor, financial advisor, or final approver.

chunks.title: LegalSkyes Business Lanes
chunks.heading: Deterministic Policy Lane Map
chunks.text: Business lane map: MetrAIyux 0S and mounted apps route to /legal/metraiyux-0s/ and the shared FS27/SkyGate/Free99/NorthStar gate rules. AI operators route to /legal/ai-terms/, /legal/ai-transparency/, and /legal/ai-operators/. SkyeMusicNexus routes to /legal/music-nexus/ plus creator/media, marketplace/commerce, payments, contractor/vendor, rights, payout, and takedown terms. SaaS platforms route to /legal/saas-platform/, /legal/service-level/, subscriptions, payments, privacy, and acceptable use. Communications route to /legal/sms-communications/, /legal/twilio-sms/, privacy, contact, and carrier proof. IP, abuse, child safety, and security route to DMCA/IP, acceptable use, child safety, and security reporting.

chunks.title: LegalSkyes Escalation Boundaries
chunks.heading: When the Brain Must Escalate
chunks.text: Escalate to human owner review and licensed counsel where appropriate when a request involves subpoenas, lawsuits, arbitration, demand letters, counter-notices, ownership disputes, child safety, employment, finance, tax, regulated professional advice, telecom compliance, security incidents, customer commitments, enterprise contracts, filings, or binding approvals. The brain must not expose private admin setup, create app-specific owner/admin passwords for mounted 0S apps, bypass the shared FS27/SkyGate/Free99 auth lane, or treat policy summaries as legal advice.
